author: Mike Kasberg

mapping.sheet: Preserve default 1.6 mm sheet; adjustable 1.6–2.4 mm
mapping.socket: Preserve 4.50 mm radial slot length; transverse slot = sheet + total allowance
mapping.fit: Source surplus .100012 mm informs proposed .15 mm total allowance, adjustable .10–.30; not calibrated
mapping.tongue: New 4.5 minus allowance mm tongue, through hub thickness, intersecting new web by .15 mm
mapping.carrier: New divided 4/3/3-bay carrier and forty .4–.6 mm bed-level runners; source .21/.22 low Z planes are not copied as universal print dimensions

newAssembly.parts: 4 outward-facing three-socket hubs + 6 doubly clipped struts
newAssembly.topology: Tetrahedron K4; all six edges have equal geometry, all hubs have three 120-degree sockets
newAssembly.shoulderConstruction: Clip planar web against both inward hub-face halfplanes at normal offset -sheet/2; only end tongues cross the receiving planes
newAssembly.assemblyPath: Hold six struts with temporary tape/support. Translate each hub inward independently along its outward normal; three parallel tongues enter three closed sockets. Apply compatible adhesive at all 12 joints after alignment. No closed-loop forced bending.
newAssembly.retention: Adhesive required, no snap/capture or friction retention claim
newAssembly.art: Exact image/mesh engraving on hub 1 only. Radial keep-in min(6.5, socketRadius − 2.25 − 1) mm preserves >=1 mm from slots; backing >=1 mm.

differenceFromPriorApps: Rigid tetrahedral edge frame with twelve normal-entry joints and six halfplane-clipped struts; not the earlier thread-laced four-face tetrahedron, two-axis radial bowl, or a cosmetic reskin. Shared editor/import/export infrastructure adapted; new model and insertion/collision tests.
